Durable agent-state substrates (denoland/celld holds a third consecutive Rust board day at +528 over the window as the one survivor of the celld / cloudflare-computer / rivet trio flagged on 08-08; the Text-to-SQL crystallization paper asks the same question from the research side — can expensive search be banked so the second run is cheap)

Agent memory (four independent papers in one batch: MemoryCPT makes the cost/quality trade-off an explicit axis, scrub-jay episodic caching supplies a what/where/when design pattern, Text-to-SQL crystallization asks whether test-time search can be banked as reusable memory, and DocMemo replaces static top-K with tri-level memory plus Bayesian belief updating)

Durable agent state (a transactional continuity kernel as the durability primitive for long-lived agents, VibeLifeBench testing persistence rather than one-shot success, AIPass giving agents persistent identity, memory and email)
Agent memory (a transactional continuity kernel proposed instead of a memory store, EvoGraph-Mem's failure-aware editable graph, MAP-Graph provenance, the first public Agent Memory Leaderboard)

Durable agent state (Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform GA holds agent state across several days; DeepSeek's harness makes the session an append-only event stream you can resume, fork and replay, and Cordis v4 underneath it can revert state and side effects on plugin unload)

Agent memory ('When Your Agent Opens the Chat App' finds agent-controlled search over raw logs rivals purpose-built memory structures — a direct argument against premature memory engineering — while RippleMem pushes the other way toward associative recollection, and OpenViking merges memory, RAG and skills into one store)
